decisions: Do not call reduction/scheduling separation, packing, fixed reductions, four-column kernels, or weight reuse independently novel.
Do not reduce LLM-42 to token verification: it repairs KV state even after successful verification.
Do not imply Vosti proves equality to an arbitrary externally chosen legacy reference.
Do not interpret mathematical exactness or unchanged output distributions as full fixed-reference state equality.
Do not convert modern few-row operator timing into full-service superiority.
